name: 47130 · Jeffersonvlle, IN
findings: ZIP 47130 (Jeffersonvlle) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47130 (Jeffersonvlle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
